cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Credit for the Discovery
cards.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you found the clue, saw through the deception, or designed the successful scheme.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. On tomorrow's house tour, will you say my diagram revealed the hidden doorway?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mum spent all week stripping that wall.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Credit her work. Then say who spotted the door before we stripped it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll let you open it for the visitors.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lovely. Introduce me as the person who found it, or they'll think I'm holding it for them.
